description: M::Box.new(7).get -- a `cpath` in *receiver* position, resolving to a class object that is then allocated. This is the join between tier 13 and tier 7: `newInst` reads the class off the receiver's `Ty.clsOf`, so it needs `cpath` to produce one, and every `Purl.new`/`Version.new` in the slice is this shape.
